description: This file defines the "EducationAPI" class within the OrangeHRM project, which provides RESTful API endpoints for managing education records in the HR management system. The class includes methods for CRUD operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting education entries, with associated validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EducationAPI
classes.description: This class provides CRUD API endpoints for managing Education records in the OrangeHRM system, including methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting education entries, with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Education record by ID, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EducationService.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all Education records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Education record based on request payload.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Sets the name on an Education entity and saves it via the EducationService.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Education record identified by ID.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the name parameter, including uniqueness constraint.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Education records by list of IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing Education records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new Education record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing Education record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting Education records.
